title: Savant Sommelier
lead: Wine intelligence — discover, learn, track, and analyze vineyard potential with explanations that answer why.
mission: Help people learn wine, find wine, track wine, and understand what could grow on a property today and decades ahead — powered by an explainable Wine Intelligence Engine.
principles: Palate learning from local ratings, favorites, purchases, and notes
No influencer scores or competitive tasting boards
Property details stay private by default
Future climate horizons are labeled scenarios, not precision forecasts

modules.title: Wine Intelligence Engine
modules.description: Layered palate → recommend → discovery → tasting → pairing → cellar → purchase intelligence.

modules.title: Discover
modules.description: Personal why, guided discovery, intelligent search, food pairing, comparisons.

modules.title: My Cellar
modules.description: Inventory plus cellar, tasting, and purchase intelligence.

modules.title: Vineyard Intelligence
modules.description: Why / why-not grapes, strengths, risks, climate trajectory with uncertainty.

modules.title: Buying architecture
modules.description: Retailer / price / availability seams — not live marketplace.

modules.title: Map overlays
modules.description: Parcel, soils, hydrology, climate, terrain contracts.

dataModel: Educational catalogs ship as JSON. Cellar, sites, wishlist, and settings stay in localStorage. No sample cellar inventory.
privacyPhilosophy: Sites, wineries, and wines stay local. Property privacy is the default — not an afterthought.
futureDirection: Authoritative DEM/climate layers, parcel soils, live retailer adapters, and friends’ recommendations — always with honesty labels.
